const input = $json;
const title = String(input.title || '').trim();
const excerpt = String(input.excerpt || '').trim();
const content = String(input.content || '').trim();
const category = String(input.category || '').trim();
const sourceUrl = String(input.source_url || '').trim();

const prompt = [
  'You are an editorial verification assistant for SharedSpace.',
  'Review the submitted article and return ONLY valid JSON.',
  '',
  'Use this schema exactly:',
  '{',
  '  "trust_score": <0-100 integer>,',
  '  "summary": "<2-3 sentence summary>",',
  '  "verdict": "<publish recommendation>",',
  '  "metrics": {',
  '    "factual_accuracy": <0-100 integer>,',
  '    "source_quality": <0-100 integer>,',
  '    "bias_detection": <0-100 integer>,',
  '    "logical_consistency": <0-100 integer>,',
  '    "completeness": <0-100 integer>',
  '  },',
  '  "source_label": "<short source note>"',
  '}',
  '',
  `Title: ${title}`,
  `Category: ${category}`,
  `Summary: ${excerpt}`,
  `Reference URL: ${sourceUrl || 'No reference URL supplied'}`,
  '',
  'Article content:',
  content
].join('\n');

return [{ json: { ...input, prompt } }];
